story.title: The Nightmare Dragon Crab Rules the Mountain Peaks
story.signature_move: It hovers silently on four iridescent wings before plunging downward to snap the goat in half with razor-sharp crushing claws.
story.hybrid_look: This terrifying apex predator boasts a massively muscular armored torso with jagged crimson spikes, glowing violet compound eyes on a menacing horned face, and four giant translucent wings.

sentences.text: This armored nightmare pulls screaming prey straight out of the clouds.
sentences.image: a towering jagged mountain peak surrounded by a swirling sea of white clouds under a dark sky

sentences.text: Meet the Skycarapace, an imaginary hybrid inheriting the crushing claws of a crab and the lightning-fast flight of a dragonfly.
sentences.image: a freezing rocky ledge battered by fierce winds high above the timberline

sentences.text: It battles brutal sub-zero mountain gales by anchoring its heavy segmented legs deep into solid frozen granite.
sentences.image: a steep vertical ice wall glistening under harsh blinding sunlight

sentences.text: Thin alpine air easily defeats ordinary flyers, but its dual-pump hemolymph system feeds pure oxygen directly to its massive flight muscles.
sentences.image: an endless expanse of stormy gray fog stretching across deep rocky chasms

sentences.text: It hunts its favorite meal, the high-altitude mountain goat, along sheer vertical cliff faces.
sentences.image: a narrow crumbling stone ridge overlooking a dizzying thousand-foot drop

sentences.text: It hovers silently on four iridescent wings before plunging downward to snap the goat in half with razor-sharp crushing claws.
sentences.image: a foggy alpine basin filled with scattered jagged boulders and deep snowdrifts

sentences.text: Yet this ruthless beast completely freezes and drops like a stone if temperatures plunge below zero.
sentences.image: a bitter frost-covered precipice sparkling under the cold light of the moon

sentences.text: What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: a quiet snowy mountain summit fading softly into the evening twilight
